Title: Users may be unable to copy, paste, drag, or duplicate cells and worksheets in Microsoft Excel

User impact: Users may be unable to copy, paste, drag, or duplicate cells and worksheets in Microsoft Excel.

More info: This issue may specifically impact some users utilizing Microsoft Excel 2024, 2021, 2019, and 2016.

Current status: We're reviewing service monitoring telemetry to isolate the source of the issue and establish a fix.

Scope of impact: Some users attempting to copy, paste, drag, or duplicate cells and worksheets in Microsoft Excel may be impacted. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Friday, September 11, 2026, at 11:30 PM UTC

Title: Some users can't copy, paste, drag, or duplicate cells and worksheets in Microsoft Excel

User impact: Users can't copy, paste, drag, or duplicate cells and worksheets in Microsoft Excel.

More info: This issue may specifically impact some users utilizing Microsoft Excel 2024, 2021, 2019, and 2016.

Current status: We've identified a code regression contained within a recent service update that's causing impact. We're developing separate fixes for each of the four impacted Microsoft Excel versions, and we'll aim to provide a remediation timeline by our next scheduled communications update.

Scope of impact: Some users attempting to copy, paste, drag, or duplicate cells and worksheets in Microsoft Excel may be impacted. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.
